title: NINEFOLD INTRINSIC — Twelve Intrinsic Dimensions

dimensions.name: OMNI
dimensions.responsibility: Universal scope, cross-domain coherence and whole-system awareness.

dimensions.name: GENESIS
dimensions.responsibility: Origin, creation, bootstrapping, initialisation and provenance of new entities and systems.

dimensions.name: NEXUS
dimensions.responsibility: Connectivity, relationships, interfaces, dependency topology and coordinated interoperability.

dimensions.name: CHRONOS
dimensions.responsibility: Temporal reasoning: history, sequencing, forecasting, temporal patterns and time-aware analysis.

dimensions.name: TEMPORAL
dimensions.responsibility: Temporal operations: scheduling, deadlines, state transitions, continuity and time-bound execution governance.

dimensions.name: QUANTUM
dimensions.responsibility: Fine-grained state, uncertainty, probabilistic reasoning, alternatives and high-resolution analysis; no unsupported quantum-computing claims.

dimensions.name: EVOLUTION
dimensions.responsibility: Adaptation, learning, controlled improvement, lifecycle progression and reversible change.

dimensions.name: ALPHA
dimensions.responsibility: Foundational initiation, baseline capability, first-principles reasoning and controlled genesis of capability.

dimensions.name: OMEGA
dimensions.responsibility: Completion criteria, integrity, lifecycle closure, value assurance and end-to-end outcome validation.

dimensions.name: META
dimensions.responsibility: Self-description, abstraction, architecture reasoning, model-of-models and reflective system analysis.

dimensions.name: COSMIC
dimensions.responsibility: Large-scale context, cross-environment integration, distributed scope and multi-system coordination.

dimensions.name: AFI PRIME
dimensions.responsibility: Unified specialist orchestration and evidence-preserving fusion across nine governed UMIC-scoped instances; one canonical fusion function.

clarifications: CHRONOS is temporal reasoning; TEMPORAL is time-dependent operational governance.
AFI PRIME remains one canonical fusion function instantiated in nine governed UMIC contexts.
Dimensions are responsibility scopes, not additional UMICs, lineage slots, runtime processes or fusion authorities.
